title: SG-4.2.1 · Depth-independent node_modules ignore rule
summary: Replace game/node_modules/ with node_modules/ in .gitignore and prove coverage of game/frontend/node_modules by a test
description: Context: .gitignore only has `game/node_modules/`, which does not match `game/frontend/node_modules`. Desired behavior: a depth-independent `node_modules/` rule, and a unit test that reads the real .gitignore and checks the path is covered. Expected result: vendored Phaser files under any node_modules are ignored. Why: avoid tracked changes in vendored Phaser files.
acceptance_criteria: Given the real .gitignore, when read, then it contains the line `node_modules/` and no longer contains `game/node_modules/`
Given the real .gitignore, when a unit test evaluates path game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/package.json, then it is reported as ignored
technical_constraints: Unit test must read the real .gitignore from disk, no git process
